title: Justin Willman: One For the Ages Tour
seo_title: Justin Willman: One For the Ages Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Justin Willman, creator and star of Netflix's Magic for Humans and Magic Prank Show, brings his One for the Ages tour with brand-new material, mixing magic and relatable humor in an interactive show. It is family-friendly and recommended for ages 8 and up because of occasional mature humor, loud or surprising moments, and a few spooky elements. It takes place Thursday, January 14, 2027, at 7:00 PM at the Gillioz Theatre, 325 Park Central, E Springfield, Missouri, with doors at 6 PM.
